title: Africa — country library / archive / database searches
body: Parent issue to hold country-level tasks for Africa. Each child issue should locate national, state/provincial, municipal, university, special-interest, and digital libraries/archives/databases and add rows to the main table in issue #2. Start at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Category:Lists_of_libraries_by_country. Deliverables: per-country CSV/table rows (institution name, city, type, URL, notes, sources) and a summary comment linking to additions in issue #2.
